subject: Day 22: week 4; first social smile watch begins
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 22. The first true social smile — directed at a face, in response to a face, not a reflexive gas-smile — typically emerges between week four and week six. Watch for it during calm, awake-alert windows.

Action items
- Confirm the 1-month well visit is booked for the day 28-35 window. AAP Bright Futures periodicity: https://www.aap.org/en/practice-management/bright-futures/bright-futures-tools-and-resources/
- Pre-write 1-month-visit questions: growth curve, feeding, sleep stretches, maternal mood, and the 2-month vaccine schedule. AAP HealthyChildren overview of the first month: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx
- Continue daycare or nanny tours and waitlist deposits. ChildCare.gov directory: https://www.childcare.gov/
- Confirm Anoushka's 6-week postpartum visit is scheduled for around day 42. ACOG on the postpartum period: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-pain-management
- Continue the feeding log.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Cradle cap; blocked tear duct; evening witching-hour fussiness building toward the peak-crying weeks.
- [low concern] First social smiles and early cooing during alert windows.
- [monitor] Crying more than three hours a day on more than three days a week — the colic pattern that peaks at six to eight weeks.
- [call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting with weight loss, which can signal pyloric stenosis presenting at weeks 3-6. Persistent inability to console with back-arching during feeds.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunities
- Hold him 8-12 inches from your face, smile, and talk slowly — the most reliable way to elicit an early social smile.
- Accumulate 15-20 minutes of tummy time across short bouts. AAP HealthyChildren on tummy time: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx
- Take conversational turns with his coos — respond, pause, respond again. Romeo et al., Psych Science 2018: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29442613/
- Read aloud daily with rhythmic, high-contrast board books.

Upcoming
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; first social smiles.
- Day 35-42: peak crying curve at about six weeks.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.
- Day 56-70: 2-month well visit; first round of vaccines.
